Eli (marketing): quick one — were polishing the launch post and want a tiny validation run focused on a 'micro-warmup' scenario. goal: show that with a short 500-token prefix warmup, p95 stabilizes compared to cold within one followup. need numbers + tiny artifact pack for the blog.

Hannah (eng-runtime): got it. define micro-warmup precisely? 500-token prime then 1 followup? or a short ramp?

Eli (marketing): micro-warmup = prime 500 tokens then send 3 quick followups (same session). also include a cold baseline (independent requests). acceptance for marketing: warmed p95 <= cold p95 * 1.35 and p50 within 10% of warmed p50. if warmed fails, marketing will fallback to citing cold median only.

Eli (marketing): example payload: ```json
{"prompt":"Convert release notes into 2 bullets","context":"<~500 tokens>"}
```

Hannah (eng-runtime): plan: - cold: 600 independent requests seq=768 - micro-warmup: 400 traces prime=500 + 3 followups - variants: fp16 and awq-int8 - hardware: 1 x V100-equivalent node - outputs: CSV of latencies, 5 raw json outputs per cell, and a short runbook. estimate ~45m.

Marcus (product): can you add a minimal quality check (5 samples) and flag any outputs with truncated sentences or missing key facts? we don't need full eval, just eyeball triggers.

Hannah (eng-runtime): will add a tiny heuristic: token-length delta and trailing punctuation check. also: do you want bursty microbursts (10rps for 30s) to emulate demo traffic?

Eli (marketing): yes add one microburst for warmed awq-int8 only: 10 rps for 30s. acceptance adds: no more than 2% requests >600ms during the burst.

Hannah (eng-runtime): sample commands: ```bash
# cold
curl -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-micro","variant":"fp16","requests":600,"seq":768}'
# micro-warmup
curl -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-micro","variant":"awq-int8","prime":500,"followups":3,"requests":400,"traces":true}'
# burst
curl -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-micro","variant":"awq-int8","burst_rps":10,"burst_dur_s":30}'
```

Eli (marketing): perfect. please post artifacts (CSV + jsonl samples + one-line pass/fail) in this thread when done. if timings tight we can accept morning+1. :rocket:
